hi_giraffe.zh: 哈囉,下面的朋友!我是長頸鹿!

fact_tiger.en: Tigers love to swim! And every tiger has its very own stripes.
fact_tiger.zh: 老虎很會游泳喔!而且每隻老虎的條紋都不一樣。

fact_monkey.en: Monkeys can hold on to branches with their long tails!
fact_monkey.zh: 猴子可以用長長的尾巴抓住樹枝喔!

fact_elephant.en: Elephants drink water with their long trunks. They even give trunk hugs!
fact_elephant.zh: 大象用長長的鼻子喝水,還會用鼻子抱抱喔!

fact_zebra.en: No two zebras have the same stripes. Every zebra is special!
fact_zebra.zh: 每一隻斑馬的條紋都不一樣,每一隻都很特別!

fact_parrot.en: Parrots can copy sounds. Hello! Hello! And they love fruit!
fact_parrot.zh: 鸚鵡會學別人說話,你好!你好!而且牠們很愛吃水果!

fact_giraffe.en: Giraffes are the tallest animals in the world. And their tongues are purple!
fact_giraffe.zh: 長頸鹿是世界上最高的動物,牠們的舌頭是紫色的喔!

sticker_giraffe.zh: 你得到一張長頸鹿貼紙!

patch_tiger.zh: 橘色的毛,還有黑色的條紋!

notme_tiger.en: Not me! I have orange fur and black stripes.
notme_tiger.zh: 不是我喔!我是橘色的,有黑色的條紋。

part_monkey.zh: 一條長長的、捲捲的尾巴!

notme_monkey.en: Not me! I have brown, fuzzy fur.
notme_monkey.zh: 不是我喔!我的毛是咖啡色的。

notme_elephant.en: Not me! I have gray skin and a long trunk.
notme_elephant.zh: 不是我喔!我是灰色的,有長長的鼻子。

part_zebra.en: A stripy head with a fuzzy mane!
part_zebra.zh: 有條紋的頭,還有毛毛的鬃毛!

notme_zebra.en: Not me! I'm black and white.
notme_zebra.zh: 不是我喔!我是黑白條紋的。

patch_parrot.en: Bright red, blue, and yellow feathers!
patch_parrot.zh: 紅色、藍色、黃色的漂亮羽毛!

notme_parrot.en: Not me! I have colorful feathers.
notme_parrot.zh: 不是我喔!我有彩色的羽毛。

patch_giraffe.zh: 黃色的,有大大的咖啡色斑點!

notme_giraffe.en: Not me! I have brown spots and a long neck.
notme_giraffe.zh: 不是我喔!我有咖啡色的斑點和長脖子。

solved_trail_monkey.en: Hee hee! It was me! The bananas were so yummy. Sorry!
solved_trail_monkey.zh: 嘻嘻!是我啦!香蕉太好吃了,對不起嘛!

solved_trail_elephant.en: It was me! I picked the bananas with my trunk. Oops! Sorry!
solved_trail_elephant.zh: 是我!我用鼻子把香蕉拿走了。哎呀,對不起!

solved_trail_parrot.en: Squawk! It was me! I love bananas! Sorry, sorry!
solved_trail_parrot.zh: 嘎嘎!是我!我最愛吃香蕉了!對不起、對不起!

solved_river_elephant.en: It was me! I was splashing with my trunk! Splash, splash!
solved_river_elephant.zh: 是我!我用鼻子噴水玩,嘩啦嘩啦!

solved_river_zebra.en: It was me! I came to the river for a cool drink.
solved_river_zebra.zh: 是我!我來河邊喝涼涼的水。

solved_river_tiger.en: Rawr! It was me! Tigers love to swim!
solved_river_tiger.zh: 吼~是我!老虎最喜歡游泳了!

solved_canopy_monkey.en: It was me! I borrowed it to look at bugs. Here you go!
solved_canopy_monkey.zh: 是我!我借來看小蟲蟲,還給你!

solved_canopy_parrot.en: Squawk! It was me! It was so shiny! Here you go!
solved_canopy_parrot.zh: 嘎嘎!是我!它亮晶晶的好漂亮!還給你!

solved_canopy_giraffe.en: It was me! My long neck reached right up here. Here you go!
solved_canopy_giraffe.zh: 是我!我的長脖子一伸就拿到了。還給你!

hello.en: Hi Milo! I'm Coco. Let's solve animal mysteries together! Tap the big green button!
hello.zh: 嗨,洛明!我是可可。我們一起去解開動物的謎題吧!按一下綠色的大按鈕!

map_pick.en: Where should we go, detective? Tap a picture!
map_pick.zh: 小偵探,我們要去哪裡呢?點一張圖吧!

journal_open.en: Here's our sticker book! Tap a sticker to hear about the animal.
journal_open.zh: 這是我們的貼紙本!點一下貼紙,聽聽動物的故事。

journal_empty.en: Who's hiding here? Solve a mystery to find out!
journal_empty.zh: 這裡躲著誰呢?解開謎題就知道囉!

journal_cases.en: Look how many mysteries you solved!
journal_cases.zh: 你看,你解開了好多謎題!

intro_trail.en: Oh no! Our picnic bananas are gone! Someone ate them! Let's be detectives and find three clues. Tap things to look around!
intro_trail.zh: 糟糕!我們野餐的香蕉不見了!是誰吃掉的呢?我們來當小偵探,找出三個線索吧!點點看四周的東西!

intro_river.en: Look! Big, wet footprints by the river! Who was splashing here? Let's find three clues!
intro_river.zh: 你看!河邊有好多濕濕的腳印!是誰在這裡玩水呢?我們來找三個線索吧!

intro_canopy.en: Uh oh! Leo's magnifying glass is missing! Someone took it up here. Let's find three clues!
intro_canopy.zh: 哎呀!里歐的放大鏡不見了!有人把它拿到樹上來了。我們來找三個線索吧!

walk_help.en: Tap the ground to walk there. Or press the big arrows!
walk_help.zh: 點一下地面,就可以走過去。也可以按大箭頭喔!

hint_look.en: Hmm, what's over there? Let's tap something!
hint_look.zh: 嗯……那邊有什麼呢?我們點點看吧!

hint_sparkle.en: Look! Something is sparkling. Tap it!
hint_sparkle.zh: 你看!有東西在閃閃發亮,點一下!

hint_walk.en: Let's walk this way! There's more to see.
hint_walk.zh: 我們往這邊走吧!還有好多東西可以看。

looked_here.en: We already looked here. Let's try something else!
looked_here.zh: 這裡我們看過了喔,換別的看看!

clue_1.en: We found one clue! Let's find two more.
clue_1.zh: 找到一個線索了!再找兩個吧。

clue_2.zh: 又一個線索!只差一個了!

clue_3.en: Three clues! Now we can solve the mystery!
clue_3.zh: 三個線索都找到了!我們可以解開謎題了!

witness_clue.en: Our new friend saw who did it! Here's a clue!
witness_clue.zh: 我們的新朋友有看到是誰喔!這是一個線索!

final_ask.en: Who matches all our clues? Tap the animal!
final_ask.zh: 誰跟我們的線索一樣呢?點一下那隻動物!

final_again.en: Let's look at the clues again.

solved_yay.en: You solved the mystery! Great detective work, Milo!
solved_yay.zh: 你解開謎題了!洛明,你真是厲害的小偵探!

play_again.en: Play again, or pick a new place!
play_again.zh: 要再玩一次,還是換個地方呢?

act_fern.en: Rustle, rustle! Who's hiding in there?

act_nest.zh: 一個鳥窩!我們看看裡面。

act_crate.en: A wooden box! Let's open it!

act_chest.en: A treasure chest! Let's open it!

act_barrel.zh: 一個漂來的木桶!裡面有什麼?

act_plank.en: This board is wiggly! Let's lift it up.
act_plank.zh: 這塊木板鬆鬆的,我們掀開看看!

act_binoculars.en: Binoculars! Let's look far, far away.
act_binoculars.zh: 望遠鏡!我們來看好遠好遠的地方。

act_basket.en: A basket on a rope! Let's pull it down.
act_basket.zh: 繩子上有一個籃子!我們把它拉下來。

act_egg.en: A big spotty egg! Let's look behind it.
act_egg.zh: 一顆有斑點的大蛋!我們看看後面。

sur_star.zh: 一顆亮晶晶的星星!一閃一閃!

sur_map.en: An old treasure map! So cool!
sur_map.zh: 一張舊舊的藏寶圖!好酷喔!

sur_nothing.en: Nothing here. Let's look somewhere else!
sur_nothing.zh: 這裡沒有東西,我們去別的地方看看!

sur_flower.en: What a pretty flower! Sniff, sniff. It smells nice!
sur_flower.zh: 好漂亮的花!聞一聞,香香的!

sur_splash.en: Splash! The water is nice and cool!

sur_lantern.en: A glowing lantern! It's warm and bright.
sur_lantern.zh: 一盞亮亮的燈籠!暖暖的好亮喔。

sur_egg.en: A big spotty egg! Shh, it's resting.
sur_egg.zh: 一顆有斑點的大蛋!噓,牠在休息喔。

sur_palm.en: Wiggle, wiggle! What a tall palm tree!

sur_orchid.en: Purple flowers! So pretty up high!
sur_orchid.zh: 紫色的花!在高高的樹上好漂亮!

count_intro_berries.en: Look at all these berries! Let's count them. Touch each one!
count_intro_berries.zh: 哇,好多藍莓!我們來數一數。每一顆都摸一下喔!

count_intro_apples.en: Look at all these apples! Let's count them. Touch each one!
count_intro_apples.zh: 哇,好多蘋果!我們來數一數。每一顆都摸一下喔!

count_intro_bananas.en: Look at all these bananas! Let's count them. Touch each one!
count_intro_bananas.zh: 哇,好多香蕉!我們來數一數。每一根都摸一下喔!

count_intro_eggs.en: Look at all these eggs! Let's count them. Touch each one!
count_intro_eggs.zh: 哇,好多蛋!我們來數一數。每一顆都摸一下喔!

count_intro_gems.en: Look at all these gems! Let's count them. Touch each one!
count_intro_gems.zh: 哇,好多寶石!我們來數一數。每一顆都摸一下喔!

count_intro_stars.en: Look at all these stars! Let's count them. Touch each one!
count_intro_stars.zh: 哇,好多星星!我們來數一數。每一顆都摸一下喔!

count_intro_cherries.en: Look at all these cherries! Let's count them. Touch each one!
count_intro_cherries.zh: 哇,好多櫻桃!我們來數一數。每一顆都摸一下喔!

count_right.en: You counted them all! Great counting!
count_right.zh: 你全部都數完了!數得好棒!

count_again.en: Hmm, not quite. Let's count them together!
count_again.zh: 嗯,好像不是喔。我們一起再數一次!

count_glow.en: This many! Tap the glowing number.
count_glow.zh: 就是這麼多!點一下發亮的數字。

count_more.en: There are more to touch! Find the ones without a number.
count_more.zh: 還有沒摸到的喔!找找看沒有數字的。

add_push.en: Let's put them all in the basket! Tap each group.
add_push.zh: 我們把它們都放進籃子裡!點一下每一堆。

add_countall.en: Now count them all together! Touch each one.
add_countall.zh: 現在全部一起數!每一個都摸一下。

add_right.en: Yes! Putting groups together is called adding!
add_right.zh: 對了!把兩堆合在一起,就是加法喔!

add_ask_1_1.zh: 一個和一個,合起來是幾個呢?

sound_teach.en: Every word starts with a sound. Listen: Lll, Lll, Leo! Leo starts with L!
sound_teach.zh: 每個詞都有開頭的聲音。聽聽看:ㄎ、ㄎ、可可!可可的開頭是ㄎ!
sound_teach.zs: 每個詞都有開頭的聲音。聽聽看:科、科、可可!可可的開頭是,科!
sound_teach.sp: Every word starts with a sound. Listen: Lll, Lll, Leo! Leo starts with L!

sound_ask_tiger.en: Now listen: Tuh, tuh, tiger! Which letter makes the tuh sound? Tap it!
sound_ask_tiger.zh: 現在聽:ㄌ、ㄌ、老虎!老虎的開頭是哪一個注音呢?點一下!
sound_ask_tiger.zs: 現在聽:勒、勒、老虎!老虎的開頭是哪一個注音呢?點一下!

sound_right_tiger.en: Yes! T says tuh. Tuh, tuh, tiger!

sound_ask_monkey.en: Now listen: Mmm, mmm, monkey! Which letter makes the mmm sound? Tap it!
sound_ask_monkey.zh: 現在聽:ㄏ、ㄏ、猴子!猴子的開頭是哪一個注音呢?點一下!
sound_ask_monkey.zs: 現在聽:喝、喝、猴子!猴子的開頭是哪一個注音呢?點一下!

sound_right_monkey.en: Yes! M says mmm. Mmm, mmm, monkey!

sound_ask_elephant.en: Now listen: Eh, eh, elephant! Which letter makes the eh sound? Tap it!
sound_ask_elephant.zh: 現在聽:ㄉ、ㄉ、大象!大象的開頭是哪一個注音呢?點一下!
sound_ask_elephant.zs: 現在聽:得、得、大象!大象的開頭是哪一個注音呢?點一下!

sound_right_elephant.en: Yes! E says eh. Eh, eh, elephant!

sound_ask_zebra.en: Now listen: Zzz, zzz, zebra! Which letter makes the zzz sound? Tap it!
sound_ask_zebra.zh: 現在聽:ㄅ、ㄅ、斑馬!斑馬的開頭是哪一個注音呢?點一下!
sound_ask_zebra.zs: 現在聽:玻、玻、斑馬!斑馬的開頭是哪一個注音呢?點一下!

sound_right_zebra.en: Yes! Z says zzz. Zzz, zzz, zebra!

sound_ask_parrot.en: Now listen: Puh, puh, parrot! Which letter makes the puh sound? Tap it!
sound_ask_parrot.zh: 現在聽:ㄧ、ㄧ、鸚鵡!鸚鵡的開頭是哪一個注音呢?點一下!
sound_ask_parrot.zs: 現在聽:衣、衣、鸚鵡!鸚鵡的開頭是哪一個注音呢?點一下!

sound_right_parrot.en: Yes! P says puh. Puh, puh, parrot!

sound_ask_giraffe.en: Now listen: Juh, juh, giraffe! Which letter makes the juh sound? Tap it!
sound_ask_giraffe.zh: 現在聽:ㄔ、ㄔ、長頸鹿!長頸鹿的開頭是哪一個注音呢?點一下!
sound_ask_giraffe.zs: 現在聽:吃、吃、長頸鹿!長頸鹿的開頭是哪一個注音呢?點一下!

sound_right_giraffe.en: Yes! G says juh. Juh, juh, giraffe!

sound_ask_deer.en: Now listen: Duh, duh, deer! Which letter makes the duh sound? Tap it!
sound_ask_deer.zh: 現在聽:ㄒ、ㄒ、小鹿!小鹿的開頭是哪一個注音呢?點一下!
sound_ask_deer.zs: 現在聽:希、希、小鹿!小鹿的開頭是哪一個注音呢?點一下!

sound_right_deer.en: Yes! D says duh. Duh, duh, deer!

letter_ok_G.en: G can say juh, like giraffe!

sound_glow.en: It's this one! Tap the glowing letter.
sound_glow.zh: 是這一個!點一下發亮的符號。
